Defined corneal stromal pigmentation; no systemic metabolic disorder is established by this localized concept.

Benign neoplasm arising in the trachea.
Nonsyndromic inherited hearing loss without established extra-auditory disease.
Varicella-zoster infection of the facial nerve and ear defines the syndrome; the vesicular eruption is an acute sign.

Hair and neurologic syndrome; joint/skeletal defects and valve regurgitation each reported in 1/1 annotated patient; microdontia omitted at cap; frequencies have limited generalizability.

Localized inflammation of the Achilles tendon or adjacent bursa; inflammation alone does not establish an immune-mediated disease.

Congenital malformation of a vein; hepatic location does not itself establish liver parenchymal damage.
